title: Can Large Language Models Generate Effective Datasets for Emotion Recognition in Conversations?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance of Emotion Recognition in Conversations (ERC) classifiers trained on datasets with natural, imbalanced emotion label distributions versus synthetically generated datasets with balanced emotion label distributions.

Evaluating the robustness and domain adaptation capabilities of models trained on general-purpose LLM-generated dialogues when tested against original datasets derived from highly specific, biased sources like scripted TV shows and social media.
